items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Vince Mendoza is the man in charge now. He’s a fine writer also.

ctx.x: I’m a Holman fan and that instantly became up there among my favorite Holman pieces.

And they won’t release it. I cannot understand that. He was certainly a favorite of that orchestra. They release Elvis Costello records and whatever. Well that’s a different thing. Vince Mendoza is the man in charge now. He’s a fine writer also.
Yes. It’s wonderful playing, it’s wonderful writing, you sound great on it, I mean, there’s nothing not to like. It’s really inventive writing.
